// A 2D direction: a Vector2D with the invariant that its magnitude is one
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_vector). The invariant is a promise of
// intent, not a runtime proof: an arbitrary Vector2D may violate unit length
// after a non-rigid transform or manual construction. Construct one via
// normalization of a non-zero displacement — the validated factories
// `FromVector` / `TryFromVector` (and the explicitly unsafe
// `FromVectorUnchecked`) in `numeric-structures.library.plato`; zero input
// is undefined. Check unit length with `IsUnit` (algebra.library.plato) for
// diagnostics.
type Direction2D
    implements IValue
{
    Vector: Vector2D;
}
